Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imagestudio

package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.imagestudio
  • Class
    Description
    EditorModel
    The editing state for the Image Studio: the original and current images, a bounded undo/redo history, the current file Path, and a dirty flag.
    EditorModel.Listener
    Notified after any model change.
    EditorModel.Op
    A single image operation, applied to the current image.
    FileStrip3D
    The bottom strip: a filmstrip of ~/Pictures thumbnails plus Open/Save/Save As controls.
    Histogram3D
    The right-hand 256-bin RGB histogram, redrawn after every model change.
    ImageCanvas3D
    The central image viewport: the current image rendered on an opaque textured quad, with mouse-wheel zoom and a reset-view control.
    ImageStudioApp
    The Image Studio application entry point.
    ImageStudioFrame3D
    The Image Studio application window: a Frame3D that lays out the lg3d-native 3D editing surface and owns the EditorModel.
    ImageStudioPanel
    The 2D/Swing counterpart of ImageStudioFrame3D: the same JAI image editor rendered as a plain Swing panel so the 2D desktop can host it as an MDI frame (registered in Desktop2DAppRegistry.PANEL_APPS under the shared start-menu descriptor's ImageStudioApp command).
    JaiProcessor
    The Java Advanced Imaging bridge for the Image Studio.
    Slider3D
    A horizontal 3D slider: a glassy track with a draggable knob, a name label and a live value label.
    Slider3D.Listener
    Notified whenever the knob moves to a new value.
    Toolbar3D
    The left-hand control panel: category tabs, a grid of operation buttons, the parameter Slider3D, and an Undo/Redo/Reset/Fit action row.
